codeSamples.title: 进程内跑 pytest 的骨架
codeSamples.code:
# 把用例模板写入临时目录,再在进程内跑 pytest
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import pytest

TEST_CODE = '''
def test_demo():
    assert 1 + 1 == 2
'''

def run_tests(work_dir):
    test_file = Path(work_dir) / 'test_demo.py'
    test_file.write_text(TEST_CODE, encoding='utf-8')
    rc = pytest.main(['-q', '-o', 'addopts=', '--rootdir', str(work_dir), str(test_file)])
    assert rc == 0

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    run_tests(d)
codeSamples.description: 用例与业务解耦:模板写入独立临时目录,pytest 只收集该文件,退出码即验收结论。

hints.text: 计时用 time.perf_counter(),它是精度最高的单调时钟;开始与结束各取一次,差值即单轮耗时。
p95 的实现:空列表返回 0.0,否则排序后取下标 int(len 乘 0.95) 减 1 的值。

codeSamples.title: P95 与多轮计时
codeSamples.code:
# 百分位比平均值更能代表真实体感
import time

def bench_retrieve(kb, query, rounds=30):
    times = []
    for _ in range(rounds):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        retrieve(query, kb)
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    return times

def p95(times):
    if not times:
        return 0.0
    o = sorted(times)
    return o[int(len(o) * 0.95) - 1]
codeSamples.description: 多轮计时冲掉偶发抖动,p95 截断最差百分之五,比平均值更贴近真实体感。

# YAML 流式写法:清单即数据,检查即循环
CHECKLIST_YAML = '''
- {name: 备份存在, desc: 备份文件在}
- {name: 延迟达标, desc: P95 不超预算}
'''

import yaml
from pathlib import Path

for item in yaml.safe_load(CHECKLIST_YAML):
    name = item['name']
    ok = Path(backup_path).exists() if name == '备份存在' else False
    print(name, ok)

结论用与运算:failed 等于 0 且性能在预算内且清单全部通过,三条件同时成立才允许上线。

codeSamples.title: 结论与聚合的写法
codeSamples.code:
# 结论是与运算:三关全过才允许上线
def build_report(stats, perf_ms, checks):
    total, passed, failed = stats
    ok = failed == 0 and perf_ms <= PERF_BUDGET_MS and all(c['ok'] for c in checks)
    return '全部通过,可以上线!' if ok else '存在未通过项,禁止上线。'
codeSamples.description: 任何一项失守都会让结论变红;失败数单独判断,杜绝用例总数为零的假阳性。
